stem: A startup's engineering lead wants an automatic email the moment forecasted monthly AWS spend is projected to exceed a set dollar limit, without having to open a dashboard to check.
rationale: AWS Budgets watches actual or forecasted cost or usage against a threshold and sends an alert by email or SNS the moment it is breached, which is exactly the automatic notification the engineering lead wants. AWS Cost Explorer visualizes and forecasts cost and usage in reports, but it does not push an alert on its own; someone has to open it. S3 Storage Lens reports on S3 storage usage, activity, and cost-optimization opportunities; it is not a billing-wide spend-threshold alerting tool. AWS Billing Conductor models custom chargeback rates across accounts for showback or chargeback purposes; it does not send spend-threshold alerts either.
